summary: Overflow handler. Reads the current buffer position via FieldGetterAt0x400; if it is not above the a2 threshold and positive, returns 0 immediately. Otherwise creates a handler object through a vtable method on the sub-struct at this+0x414, initializes it with sub_586800(0,13,0,1,this->0x40C), processes the buffer position through SingleFunctionCallWrapper_6a00(this, this->0x400), issues a second vtable call passing this->0x410, and records the result of VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall (success when 0). Always resets state via FieldConstantsInitialization before returning.

Invoke SingleFunctionCallWrapper_6a00(this, this->0x400) to process the buffer position through the overflow path.
